Features

Built for the way Indian agents actually work

WhatsApp-first. AI-augmented. No data entry penalty.

WhatsApp inbox

Sync your WhatsApp Business chats. Reply, broadcast, send templates — all from one dashboard.

AI requirement extraction

Auto-pulls budget, location, land size and property type from every chat. Zero typing.

Smart client profiles

Buyer, seller, investor, rental — categorized and tagged with full conversation history.

Property matching

AI matches your listings to buyer requirements and suggests the next 3 leads to call.

Never miss a follow-up

"You forgot to follow up with Rajesh about the Kakkanad plot." Smart, timely nudges.

Natural language search

"Buyers under 50 lakh in Kochi" or "villas in Kakkanad" — just type, get results.
